standard-dialogue.npc: Hello adventurer, what can I do for you?

options.text: What's that cute creature wandering around?

steps.text: Continues in Transcript:The Eyes of Glouphrie

steps.npc: It's always a pleasure to catch up with an another mage! Especially one who has helped me so much!

steps.text: If the player does not have a crystal saw or crystal seed:

steps.npc: Oh, by the way, I found this odd thing lying around, does it belong to you?

steps.text: Brimstail shows you a small crystal seed.

steps.player: Oh, yes - I was wondering where that had gone...

steps.npc: You should look after your things more carefully you know...

steps.text: If the player has a crystal saw or crystal seed:

steps.player: Oh, not so bad. I'll let you know if I find anything I think you'll find interesting...

steps.text: If the player has a crystal seed or uses it on Brimstail:

steps.npc: Fascinating ... a crystal seed. You should have a look at the crystal bowl in the other room, must be related...

steps.text: If the player has a crystal saw or uses it on Brimstail:

steps.npc: I've no idea, it must have been Oaknock's, he liked talking to the elves.

steps.player: Where would I find out how the thing works?

steps.npc: Errm, I'm not sure. Have a chat with Hazelmere, maybe he'll know. He was around when
Oaknock was alive and might have seen him use it.

steps.player: Excellent idea, I'll do that. Thanks.

options.text: Can you teleport me to the Rune Essence Mine?

steps.player: Can you teleport me to the Rune Essence?

steps.text: Brimstail teleports the player to the rune essence mine.

gnome-restaurant-dialogue.text: If the player doesn't have the correct item in their inventory:

steps.text: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!

gnome-restaurant-dialogue.text: If the player has a premade item in their inventory:

steps.text: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.

gnome-restaurant-dialogue.text: If the player has the correct item in their inventory:

steps.text: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] to Brimstail

steps.npc: You have my gratitude, young delivery person!

steps.text: If the player does have a reward token available:
You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
If the player has an unclaimed reward token:
Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
If the player has claimed their reward token:

gnome-restaurant-dialogue.text: If the player ran out of time:

steps.text: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
